name: ZombieLoad
impact: Microarchitectural fill-buffer data sampling leaks in-flight data across privilege and enclave boundaries, including from Intel SGX enclaves
mitigation: Intel microcode updates (MDS mitigation: buffer overwrite on transition) plus disabling SMT for cross-hyperthread protection
boundary_statement: ZombieLoad (CVE-2018-12130, Microarchitectural Fill Buffer Data Sampling) leaks in-flight data across boundaries including Intel SGX enclaves; mitigations ship as Intel MDS microcode updates. Intel SGX is not a platform in this taxonomy and the MDS class predates TDX and SEV-SNP, so no platform is tagged.

INTENT.evidence: Red Hat MDS advisory: CVE-2018-12130 (MFBDS) 'is referred to by researchers as RIDL or ZombieLoad'; the advisory targets Intel SGX-era hardware, with no TDX or SEV-SNP product.
